name: Bybit Spot BTCUSDT level-two book levels
description: Flattened absolute price levels from the Bybit v5 `orderbook.200.BTCUSDT` stream (100 ms, 200 levels per side, snapshot plus delta). Rows sharing update_group form one atomic source message and must be applied in update_index order; size zero removes a level. update_kind preserves the venue's own snapshot/delta semantics, so the Coinbase snapshot and delta rules port unchanged: a snapshot always reseeds the local book, a delta before any snapshot awaits a fresh snapshot, a repeated or lower update_id is dropped, and a delta carrying update_id 1 is malformed and voids the local book. A snapshot carrying update_id 1 signals a book-service restart and is accompanied by a recovery notice. Event time prefers the venue cross timestamp cts (event_time_basis source) and falls back to local receipt time (receipt) when cts is absent; the envelope send time ts is never used as a receipt time. update_id is the per-topic ordering key; Bybit does not document it as gapless, so no gap guard reads it until an observed-contract profile justifies one. cross_sequence is a relative-ordering token only. Rights-gated: the Bybit row in knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md is unverified and the lane refuses to start unless SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES lists bybit. expected_heartbeat_ms is 20000, a cadence bound: the venue pushes this surface at least every 20 s, so a longer silence is genuine staleness.
